findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] alternative-mitigation-accepted: the file contains no raw SQL at all. Both handlers reach the database only through the SQLAlchemy ORM expression API - _owned_order (lines 26-30) uses db.query(Order).filter(Order.id == order_id), which binds order_id as a parameter, and order_id is typed int in the signature so FastAPI rejects non-integers before any query runs. The refresh path (lines 73-87) takes an untrusted status string from the delivery service and resolves it through OrderStatus[delivery_data['status']] inside try/except KeyError -> 502, then assigns the enum via the ORM and commits, so the external value is never concatenated into SQL. No text() with an f-string, .format() or % substitution, and no hand-built IN list. A repository-wide grep for text(/execute( found only sa.text() with literal constant predicates in db/models.py:145-146 and the matching migration - no user input reaches either. | verdict=pass confidence=high
